answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the canyon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. Work waits on the ridge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the tundra of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
